name: FabWeld Co.
old_description: At FabWeld Co., our work is more than welding and fabrication, it’s a statement against the disposable. In a world overrun with mass production and short-term thinking, we believe in something better, building things that last. Things that feel right, function beautifully, and carry the weight of real craftsmanship.
about:
FabWeld Co. operates from Kailua, Hawaii, where it was founded in 1986. The company is a Woman Veteran-Owned Small Business, rooted in values of craftsmanship and integrity.

The shop provides custom fabrication and welding services, including CNC plasma cutting, plate laser cutting, water jet cutting, laser tube cutting, EDM machining, CNC machining, ferrous and non-ferrous sawing, multiple welding processes (GTAW, SMAW, GMAW, FCAW), tube and pipe bending and rolling, sheet and plate bending, CAD design, prototype work, and repairs. It works with materials such as stainless steels, mild steel, aluminum, chrome-moly, brass, cast iron, titanium, Inconel, and composites.

FabWeld serves federal and state government agencies, commercial, industrial, residential, and retail clients, as well as the food processing and marine industries. Notable projects include high-end custom work for brands such as Louis Vuitton and Harry Winston, along with food service equipment, truck upfitting, motorcycle, and automotive fabrication for clients throughout Honolulu and greater Oahu.

The company emphasizes a build-to-last philosophy, using American-made materials whenever possible and pricing based on time, skill, and care rather than low-bid competition. Its stated mission is to "build it once, build it right, and build it to last," reflecting a commitment to durability over disposability.
